Sanjay Manjrekar publicly criticised the selection decision
Samson omitted during active T20 series against England
Selection has reignited debate over India's T20 squad management

stories.headline: Suryakumar Yadav's candid 'Mujhe? Arey accha toh chal raha hai' response to India question goes viral
stories.what: India T20 captain Suryakumar Yadav's casual and disarming response to a question about his India future has gone viral, with the cricketer reportedly saying 'Mujhe? Arey accha toh chal raha hai' — loosely translated as 'Me? Hey, it's going fine.' The relaxed reply, captured on video, has endeared him further to fans who appreciate his laid-back demeanour under pressure. The clip spread widely on social media as India's T20 series against England draws significant public attention.
stories.lens: SKY's unscripted, self-assured response is a reminder of why he connects so deeply with fans — and offers a glimpse of the mental composure that defines his batting too.
stories.article:
Suryakumar Yadav has never been one to overthink, and a viral video clip from the India vs England T20 series perfectly encapsulates why he has become one of Indian cricket's most beloved figures. When asked a probing question about his India situation, the T20 captain responded with characteristic ease: 'Mujhe? Arey accha toh chal raha hai' — a phrase that roughly translates to 'Me? Hey, things are going well' — delivered with the kind of breezy confidence that has defined his entire cricketing persona.

The clip, reported by The Times of India, spread rapidly across social media platforms, drawing an outpouring of affection from fans who see in Suryakumar a cricketer unburdened by external noise. In a sport where press conferences and public appearances often produce carefully managed responses, his unfiltered candour stands out sharply.

Suryakumar's place in Indian cricket — particularly in the T20 setup — has occasionally been the subject of debate, given the churn in selections and the presence of other talented batters competing for spots. But his own apparent equanimity about his standing suggests a player at peace with his game and his place in the team.

For fans, the moment is more than just a funny clip — it is a reflection of the mindset of a batter who has consistently performed under pressure at the highest level. As India look to regroup after their loss to England, his attitude may well be the steadying influence the dressing room needs.
key_facts: Suryakumar Yadav's casual reply to an India question went viral
SKY said 'Mujhe? Arey accha toh chal raha hai' when asked about his India future
Clip spread widely during the India vs England T20 series
Response praised for its candour and relaxed confidence

stories.headline: Sohail Khan recalls Salim Khan's terrifying health scare: 'Doctor said you might lose him'
stories.what: Actor Sohail Khan has opened up about a deeply personal and frightening episode in which his father, legendary screenwriter Salim Khan, slipped into what he describes as a 'semi-coma'. In a candid conversation, Sohail recalled the doctor warning the family that they might lose him. The revelation sheds new light on the health struggles faced by the 88-year-old Salim Khan, one of Hindi cinema's most celebrated writers.
stories.lens: Salim Khan co-wrote some of Bollywood's most iconic scripts — his health and his family's candid accounts resonate deeply with generations of Indian film lovers.
stories.article:
Sohail Khan has spoken with rare candour about a harrowing medical emergency involving his father, the iconic screenwriter Salim Khan, revealing that the veteran had slipped into a 'semi-coma' and that doctors had warned the family they might lose him. The disclosure, made in an interview carried by The Indian Express, offers an unusually intimate glimpse into one of Bollywood's most storied families during an extremely difficult period.

Salim Khan, who along with writing partner Javed Akhtar forged some of Hindi cinema's most enduring screenplays — including Sholay, Deewar, and Don — is a figure of enormous cultural significance. His health, therefore, commands attention well beyond his immediate circle. Sohail's account of the doctor's grim prognosis underlines how serious the episode was for the entire family.

The Khan family, which includes actors Salman, Arbaaz and Sohail, is among the most prominent in Indian entertainment. Sohail's decision to speak publicly about such a private family crisis reflects a broader shift among Bollywood personalities towards greater openness about health and vulnerability — a theme that has resonated strongly with Indian audiences in recent years.

Salim Khan has not made a formal public statement on his health at the time of this report. The family's willingness to discuss the incident, however, has drawn widespread empathy and a flood of well-wishes from fans and colleagues across the industry.
key_facts: Salim Khan slipped into a 'semi-coma', per Sohail Khan's account
Doctor warned the family: 'You might lose him'
Salim Khan is legendary screenwriter known for Sholay and Deewar

stories.headline: Mumbai rains flood Amitabh Bachchan's Jalsa compound — viral video surfaces
stories.what: Heavy Mumbai rains have caused water to enter the compound of Amitabh Bachchan's iconic Juhu bungalow, Jalsa, with a viral video circulating online showing the flooding. The footage has drawn significant attention given the residence's status as one of Bollywood's most famous addresses. The incident highlights the severity of this season's monsoon lashing Mumbai, which has impacted residents across all localities, including the city's wealthiest neighbourhoods.
stories.lens: When even Bollywood royalty's home floods, it underscores how badly Mumbai's drainage infrastructure struggles every monsoon — a problem that affects millions of ordinary residents far more acutely.
stories.article:
Mumbai's intense monsoon rains have breached even the most iconic addresses in the city, with a viral video showing floodwater entering the compound of Amitabh Bachchan's celebrated Juhu bungalow, Jalsa. The footage, which spread rapidly across social media, captured the waterlogging inside the residence's grounds, reflecting the broader deluge that the city has been battling.

Jalsa is widely regarded as one of Hindi cinema's most famous private residences, drawing fans who gather outside its gates — particularly on Bachchan's birthdays. The fact that its compound is visibly flooded has amplified the video's reach, with viewers across India commenting on both the extent of this year's rains and the enduring fragility of Mumbai's drainage systems.

Mumbai's monsoon season reliably overwhelms the city's infrastructure each year, flooding low-lying areas and disrupting transport, power and daily life for millions. The images from Jalsa serve as a stark reminder that extreme rainfall spares no neighbourhood — though the consequences for ordinary Mumbaikars in informal settlements and low-lying suburbs are invariably far more severe and prolonged.

The video had not drawn any official statement from the Bachchan family at the time of reporting. The Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai has been on alert as the city continues to receive heavy rainfall, with forecasts suggesting the intense spell is likely to continue.
key_facts: Floodwater entered Amitabh Bachchan's Jalsa compound in Juhu, Mumbai
A video of the flooding went viral on social media
Incident reflects broader severe monsoon flooding hitting Mumbai

stories.headline: Lock Upp: Shresta Iyer evicted as Ram Kapoor pleads to exit the show
stories.what: The reality show Lock Upp saw two major developments: Shresta Iyer — sister of Indian cricketer Shreyas Iyer — was evicted from the show, while veteran actor Ram Kapoor made an emotional plea to leave. Shresta's eviction ends her run on the controversial captivity-themed show, while Ram Kapoor's distress signals potential drama ahead for the ongoing season. The double development has set social media abuzz among the show's dedicated viewership.
stories.lens: Lock Upp thrives on exactly this kind of high-drama volatility — a cricketer's sibling exiting alongside a veteran actor's breakdown keeps the reality show firmly in the national conversation.
stories.article:
Lock Upp's latest episode delivered high drama on two fronts: Shresta Iyer, the sister of Indian cricket star Shreyas Iyer, has been evicted from the show, while veteran actor Ram Kapoor broke down and begged to be allowed to leave. The twin developments have generated significant buzz online, reflecting the reality show's formula of combining celebrity names with high-tension confinement.

Shresta Iyer's presence on Lock Upp had drawn attention partly due to her famous sibling, and her eviction marks the end of a stint watched closely by cricket and entertainment fans alike. Ram Kapoor, a well-known face on Indian television known for shows like Bade Achhe Lagte Hain, pleading to exit the show adds an uncomfortable emotional dimension — raising questions about the participants' wellbeing within Lock Upp's demanding format.

Lock Upp, the captivity-based reality show, has consistently generated controversy since its inception, placing celebrities in jail-themed settings with limited resources and constant scrutiny. The show's producers have built its appeal around exactly these moments of emotional breakdown and dramatic elimination.

The episode has triggered debate among viewers and commentators about the emotional cost of such formats and whether the show adequately supports its contestants. Ram Kapoor's future on the show and the response from production were not confirmed at the time of reporting.
key_facts: Shresta Iyer, sister of cricketer Shreyas Iyer, evicted from Lock Upp
Ram Kapoor begged producers to let him leave the show
Lock Upp is a captivity-themed celebrity reality show

stories.headline: Aamir Khan and Gauri Spratt wed in intimate home ceremony
stories.what: Aamir Khan has married Gauri Spratt in a private, intimate ceremony held at home, with the couple's first wedding photograph now making the rounds. The wedding marks Aamir's third marriage, following his previous marriages to Reena Dutta and Kiran Rao. The low-key affair — reportedly held at his residence — is in stark contrast to the high-profile Bollywood weddings that typically dominate headlines.
stories.lens: One of Bollywood's biggest stars quietly tying the knot at home will fuel weeks of conversation about celebrity privacy and the changing nature of filmi weddings.
stories.article:
Aamir Khan has married Gauri Spratt in a quiet, intimate ceremony conducted at his home, with the couple's first official wedding photograph now public. The understated affair, held away from the fanfare typically associated with Bollywood's biggest names, signals the actor's deliberate choice to keep his personal life private — a stance he has maintained more consistently in recent years.

Gauri Spratt, who has been linked to Aamir for some time, joins his life as his third wife. Aamir was previously married to Reena Dutta, with whom he has two children, Junaid and Ira, and later to filmmaker and activist Kiran Rao, with whom he shares son Azad. His divorce from Kiran Rao in 2021 was announced with an unusually candid joint statement that drew wide attention.

The first wedding photograph, described as capturing the couple in an intimate setting at home, quickly went viral, with fans and fellow industry members reacting across social media. The simplicity of the occasion — no grand venue, no celebrity-studded guest list visible — has been noted as refreshingly different from the elaborate multi-day events that have become the norm for big Bollywood names.

For Aamir, who remains one of Hindi cinema's most commercially powerful actors, the marriage is a significant personal milestone. With several high-profile projects in his pipeline, the wedding news is certain to dominate entertainment headlines in the days ahead.
key_facts: Aamir Khan married Gauri Spratt in an intimate home ceremony
First wedding photograph of the couple has been released
This is Aamir's third marriage
Previous marriages were to Reena Dutta and Kiran Rao

stories.headline: OTT releases this week (June 29–July 5): New movies and shows on Netflix, JioHotstar, Prime Video and more
stories.what: A fresh slate of movies and shows is arriving across streaming platforms this week, spanning June 29 to July 5, with new content landing on Netflix, JioHotstar and Prime Video among others. The week's lineup includes regional-language titles — notably Telugu film Peddi and the Mollywood Times series from Malayalam cinema — alongside mainstream Hindi and international content. With multiple platforms competing for attention simultaneously, viewers have an unusually packed week of choices.
stories.lens: Knowing what's dropping and where helps India's rapidly growing streaming audience plan their weekend — especially as regional-language OTT content continues to surge in popularity.
stories.article:
Streaming platforms are serving up a packed week of fresh content from June 29 to July 5, with Netflix, JioHotstar, Prime Video and others all adding new titles to their catalogues. The week's releases span languages and genres, with both regional and pan-India offerings entering the mix simultaneously.

Among the notable arrivals are Peddi, a Telugu film, and Mollywood Times, a Malayalam production, both arriving on OTT — a reflection of the accelerating trend of South Indian cinema and web series finding large audiences through direct digital releases. The regional content segment has been one of the fastest-growing areas on Indian streaming platforms over the past two years, driven by audiences who watched the digital success of films like Pushpa and RRR on streaming.

Netflix, JioHotstar and Prime Video continue to be the dominant battlegrounds, each investing heavily in Indian originals and acquiring theatrical titles for their platforms. The simultaneous release of content across these services intensifies the competition for viewer time and subscriber retention.

For audiences, the week represents a broad spread of options — from regional dramas to what the platforms are billing as must-watch series. A detailed breakdown is available via The Economic Times' OTT tracker, which lists the full titles and their respective platforms and release dates.
key_facts: OTT releases span June 29 to July 5 across Netflix, JioHotstar, Prime Video
Telugu film Peddi and Mollywood Times are among notable regional arrivals
Multiple major platforms releasing new content simultaneously this week
